name: Voice Message Reader
subtitle: Audio to Text for Voice Notes
description:
Voice Message Reader turns voice messages into text in seconds. Can't listen right now? In a meeting, in class, on the train or somewhere noisy? Just read it.

Share any voice note from WhatsApp, Telegram, Signal, Voice Memos or any app, tap Transcribe, and the text appears instantly, right inside the share sheet. No copying, no switching apps.

WHY PEOPLE LOVE IT
• Read voice messages instead of listening, quietly and privately
• Transcribe in one tap from the share sheet
• Speech to text in 50+ languages
• Works with voice notes, audio files and videos

POWERFUL FEATURES
• AI Summary: get the key points of long voice notes in one tap
• Smart Replies: suggested answers you can send right away (on supported iPhones)
• Translate: convert the transcript into any language
• Live Transcription: record and see your words appear as you speak, great for meetings, lectures and memos
• Playback speed: listen at 0.75x to 2x while reading along
• Timeline view: tap any line to jump to that moment in the audio
• Export: save as PDF, TXT or SRT subtitles, or copy and share
• History: search all transcriptions, add favorites and organize with folders
• Face ID lock: keep your messages private
• Siri Shortcuts and Home Screen widget

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No accounts, no servers, no ads, no tracking. Transcription uses Apple speech recognition, on your iPhone whenever your language supports it. Your messages are saved only on your device.

HOW IT WORKS
1. Press and hold a voice message
2. Tap Forward, then the Share button
3. Choose Transcribe (or Voice Reader)
4. Read the text, copy it, translate it or get a summary

Perfect for busy professionals, students, travelers, multilingual families and anyone who is deaf or hard of hearing.

VOICE READER PRO
Try 3 transcriptions free. Upgrade to Pro for unlimited transcriptions, AI summaries, translation, live recording and export. Weekly, monthly and yearly plans are available; the yearly plan includes a free trial.

Payment is charged to your Apple ID at confirmation of purchase. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel anytime in your App Store account settings.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://noorulainlari.github.io/voicereader-site/privacy.html

Voice Message Reader is an independent app and is not affiliated with WhatsApp, Meta, Telegram or Signal.
